## User outcome

What problem does this solve, and which PRODUCT.md scenario or principle does it serve? For maintenance work, explain the reliability or contributor benefit.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behaviour. Explain any effect on the Applications → End task → Force quit journey and why any added complexity belongs where it does.

## Verification

What did you actually check, against which environment? Include a screenshot for UI changes or explain why capture was unavailable. Distinguish automated checks, live desktop checks and unverified assumptions.

## Remaining gaps

List relevant limitations or follow-up work. If product direction changes, explain the maintainer decision and update PRODUCT.md.
